description: The final season replaces departing residents with new rivalries but keeps the old machinery running: Amanda, Peter, Kyle, Lexi, Michael, Jane, Megan and Ryan cycle through marriages, betrayals, family revelations and business warfare until the courtyard's long-running entanglements finally begin to resolve.

s07e01.description: Amanda follows Rory to the Dominican Republic for marriage, unaware that his real plan is to kill her and inherit her money.

s07e02.description: Peter admits he still loves Amanda, while Lexi discovers her father's financial crimes may leave her personally exposed.

s07e03.description: Taylor works on Michael's resistance to fatherhood as he begins dating his receptionist and tries to keep his domestic chaos compartmentalized.

s07e04.description: Michael escapes Taylor by attending his Chicago college reunion, where nostalgia and old relationships complicate his present life.

s07e05.description: Taylor follows Michael back to Los Angeles, forcing him to juggle her presence with Jane until both women discover the deception.

s07e06.description: Amanda is kidnapped for a million-dollar ransom, and Peter joins Kyle in the effort to recover her safely.

s07e07.description: After the ransom exchange, Peter tries to become Amanda's rescuer while Amanda makes her own dangerous escape attempt.

s07e08.description: Megan turns back toward Michael after Cooper leaves, only for Michael to surprise her by proposing marriage to Jane.

s07e09.description: Michael follows Megan to the family ranch and meets the parents whose troubled history helps explain the life she left behind.

s07e10.description: Michael's confrontation with Alex fuels an obsessive test of Jane's fidelity, while Megan begins working for Lexi.

s07e11.description: Lexi uses dinner with Megan and Ryan to display her business strength, rattling Amanda as Ryan quietly studies Lexi's agenda.

s07e12.description: Michael finally admits spying on Jane to test her loyalty, and Jane makes their wedding conditional on him stopping.

s07e13.description: Jane temporarily returns to Melrose and models for Alex, giving Michael fresh reasons to monitor her despite his promises.

s07e14.description: Amanda sends Jane to Chicago to protect Alex's account, while Jane insists the trip will remain strictly professional.

s07e15.description: Michael and Jane reach their wedding day as Lexi interferes with Ryan's attendance and Jane begins doubting the marriage herself.

s07e16.description: Peter and Eve return to Peter's hometown after his father's death, forcing Peter to reconsider his choices and future.

s07e17.description: Kyle finally learns the violent history connecting Amanda and Eve and the secret they have protected since their youth.

s07e18.description: Michael's attempt to sell the beach house invites a new seduction, while Jane revisits memories of how their relationship first began.

s07e19.description: A Christmas misunderstanding leaves Peter, Michael, Kyle, Ryan and Louis mistaken for bank robbers, turning holiday goodwill into police trouble.

s07e20.description: Lexi adopts a businesslike strategy for finding romance, while Jane and Michael discover how expensive their legal troubles have become.

s07e21.description: Michael diverts hospital money into Perry's questionable investment scheme and quickly discovers that easy profit carries ugly consequences.

s07e22.description: A drunken revelation from Kyle sends Peter to Eve's hometown to investigate the part of her past she has concealed.

s07e23.description: Kyle and Ryan's domineering father arrives for Kyle's birthday, reopening family tensions just as Valentine's Day approaches.

s07e24.description: Kyle disappears after setting fire to his future home site and reveals a secret that reframes his recent breakdown.

s07e25.description: Amanda visits Kyle in rehabilitation without reconciliation, while gossip about her relationship with Peter begins spreading.

s07e26.description: Amanda recovers in hospital as rumors about her and Peter intensify despite both denying an affair.

s07e27.description: Lexi tries to break up Ryan and Megan by manipulating a proposal, expecting fear and flight to do the work for her.

s07e28.description: Ryan vanishes shortly after proposing to Megan, apparently fulfilling Lexi's scheme but for reasons she failed to anticipate.

s07e29.description: Michael and Lexi investigate Ryan's secret by posing as clergy, an undignified disguise that leads them closer to the truth.

s07e30.description: Conflict among Ryan, Megan, Michael and Lexi pushes Ryan toward a more serious relationship with his daughter Sarah.

s07e31.description: Amanda revives her ruthless management style and begins firing employees to finance Marlin's high-stakes commercial project.

s07e32.description: Marlin moves to seduce Eve and orders Amanda to distract Peter so the scheme can proceed without interference.

s07e33.description: Amanda's completed project for Marlin is destroyed, pushing her to close the company just as professional alliances fracture.

s07e34.description: Marlin dies unexpectedly, leaving Lexi and Michael with the grotesquely practical problem of moving his body back home.

s07e35.description: After the final accident, Ryan repairs the conflict between Megan and Terry as the surviving residents begin moving toward uncertain new lives.
